source.reading_method: Manual readings of the printed average curve. Values rounded to 5 mA. Fit point is separated from seven withheld readings; no precision digitization or individual tube calibration.

limits: The checked range is 5–40 V forward drop at nominal 35 V heater; values outside are explicitly extrapolated.
An average manufacturer curve is not a PT-44 factory voltage target or a model of heater/emission variation.
No reverse leakage/breakdown, saturation, cold-heater or nonlinear lamp validation.
The GE 18 V/200 mA reference remains an explicitly named alternative; its power law is not validated against this RCA curve.
